exports.name: DynamicExtensionComponent
exports.summary:
Dynamically instantiates a component registered in the `Dui` component factory registry
under the given `xtype`, based on runtime `config`.
exports.summaryZh: 根据运行时 `config`，动态实例化在 `Dui` 组件工厂注册表中以给定 `xtype` 注册的组件。

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Identifier assigned to (or read back from) the dynamically created component's config.
inputs.descriptionZh: 赋予（或从）动态创建组件的配置中读回的标识符。

inputs.name: xtype
inputs.description: The registered factory key used to look up which component to instantiate.
inputs.descriptionZh: 用于查找应实例化哪个组件的已注册工厂键名。

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Runtime configuration passed to (or an already-rendered reference reused by) the dynamic component.
inputs.descriptionZh: 传递给动态组件的运行时配置（或复用一个已渲染完成的引用）。

inputs.name: keep
inputs.description: When `true`, the dynamically created component instance is not destroyed on `ngOnDestroy`.
inputs.descriptionZh: 为 `true` 时，`ngOnDestroy` 阶段不会销毁动态创建的组件实例。

properties.name: content
properties.descriptionZh: 承载动态创建组件的视图容器。

properties.name: componentRef
properties.description: Reference to the dynamically created component instance.
properties.descriptionZh: 动态创建的组件实例的引用。

exports.name: ExtensionsModule
exports.summary: Angular module `ExtensionsModule` declaring and exporting extensions module components, directives, pipes, and providers.
exports.summaryZh: Angular 模块 `ExtensionsModule`，声明并导出Extensions模块相关的组件、指令、管道与服务提供者。
